title: Writing Functions
introduction: Functions give behaviour a name and define how values enter and leave a reusable operation.
learningOutcomes: Identify return types, parameters and arguments.
Write a function that returns a calculated value.
Explain why const references are useful for read-only inputs.

activities.question: Which keyword means a function returns no value?
activities.explanation: void is the return type used when a function performs work without returning a value.

activities.question: Passing a large read-only value as const Type& can avoid copying it.
activities.explanation: A const reference aliases the original value without copying and prevents the function from modifying it through that parameter.
